Assertions.Description: Create and explicitly save one uniquely named Fit/Pixel preset through Settings. Invoke Image Resizer on the owned Explorer selection and confirm the exact preset reaches the size selector and can be selected through the UI.
The selection includes an owned animated GIF. Confirm the shipped Image Resizer GIF warning is visible before resizing.

Resize the selected PNG and animated GIF once in copy-output mode. Confirm processing completes, exactly one correctly named and sized resized copy is produced per selected image, and both original files remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

Disable Image Resizer through Settings and confirm a real Explorer image-selection context menu remains present while Resize with Image Resizer is absent. Observe modern and classic menus on Windows 11, or classic on Windows 10, without restarting Explorer or PowerToys.

Re-enable Image Resizer and confirm its command and icon return on the required menu surfaces. Invoke the entry and confirm one usable Image Resizer window receives the selected owned image. Close without processing and restore the original enabled state.
